definitions.explanation: The posterior part of the body that one sits on.
The back or trailing part of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}り→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦すぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧{尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: My bottom hurts from sitting in a chair too long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{尻|しり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}いて→拭く：04261_fuku⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.notes: ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{尻|しり} is the polite form

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軽|かる}くて→軽い：00785_karui⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He's restless and changes jobs quickly.
examples.notes: {尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ = restless, fickle

examples.english: I lined up at the back of the queue.

examples.japanese: ⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{尻|しり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦シミ→染み：05426_shimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: There's a stain on the back part of the skirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すり{減|へ}って→すり減る：10381_suriheru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}わ→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: The heels of my shoes are worn down, so I need to buy new ones.

notes:
Can be considered slightly crude in formal contexts. Alternative polite forms exist.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧ - reluctant to get up/act, slow to start
- {尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ - restless, fickle, doesn't stay in one place
- {尻|しり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敷|し}かれる→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ - to be henpecked (lit. to be sat on)
- {尻|しり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ - to have a fire under one's seat (to be in a desperate hurry)
- ⟦{尻尾|しっぽ}→しっぽ：09089_shippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ - to show one's true colors (lit. to show one's tail)

POLITE ALTERNATIVES:
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{尻|しり} (polite form)
